## [2.33.1] - 2026-10-02

### Security

- **SPARQL queries can no longer make the server fetch a URL.** rdflib answers a `SERVICE <url>` clause with an outbound HTTP request, so any caller of the SPARQL endpoints could make the API request an arbitrary address, the cloud metadata service included. `SERVICE` is now refused with a 400 before the query runs. `FROM` and `FROM NAMED` are refused too: on a model graph they were ignored, but on a dataset-backed graph rdflib loads each source, a URL or a local path

- **Compilation is about 2.4x faster on a large model.** Every read of a model's measure namespace rebuilt the synthesized row counts, and one compilation read it hundreds of times: about 30 rebuilds per TPC-DS query. The namespace is now computed once per model per compilation, so a role-expanded copy of the model still gets its own. On the TPC-DS example model and its 40 queries (DuckDB), the mean compile time drops from 5.9 ms to 2.4 ms, the p95 from 18.2 ms to 5.1 ms, and the slowest query (Q83) from 19
